description: VISUAL-ONLY FINE-TUNING (no text labels) from thin_stroke_preservation_v1_academic checkpoint using real ANRI document. Strategy: (1) Load pretrained weights, (2) Lower LR (1e-5), (3) Minimal epochs (15), (4) DISABLE CTC/HTR components (discriminator_mode=clean, ctc_loss_weight=0.0), (5) Focus on PSNR/SSIM visual quality only.

experiment_metadata.hypothesis: Fine-tuning pretrained model on real ANRI document strips will improve visual quality on domain-specific degradation patterns while preserving thin stroke preservation capability.

finetuning_strategy.early_stopping_patience: Reduced to 8 epochs (prevent overfitting on small dataset)
finetuning_strategy.focus_metric: PSNR only (visual quality, not HTR accuracy)
finetuning_strategy.minimal_epochs: 15 epochs max to prevent catastrophic forgetting
finetuning_strategy.data_strategy: Sequential split on strips (top→train, middle→val, bottom→test) to prevent data leakage

risks.overfitting: HIGH - only 1 document, many correlated strips. Mitigated by: (1) sequential split, (2) augmentation, (3) early stopping patience=8
risks.catastrophic_forgetting: MEDIUM - fine-tuning might forget original synthetic data patterns. Mitigated by: (1) low LR, (2) minimal epochs
risks.data_leakage: NONE - sequential split ensures no correlation between train/val/test

experiment_metadata.expected_outcome: Model adapts to real ANRI document degradation patterns while maintaining thin stroke preservation from base model
